value.rationale: The yes/no chord-crossing event is affine invariant and entirely blind to ellipse anisotropy. The squared sine of crossing angle is an equally natural measurable geometric statistic, but its full exact response is shape-injective and sharply stable near the circle. This is a complete inverse classification for an infinite, geometrically natural family, not merely a numerical constant or arithmetic rearrangement; the leading and logarithmic tail terms quantify distinct degeneration mechanisms.
